en:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?
Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.

There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.
Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!
You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.
Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?
With what would you like to \nexchange it?
Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?
Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.
This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?
That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.
Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.
